build_boxinst_detector: build a BoxInst instance segmentation model with backbone, neck, bbox_head, and mask_head configs
extract_features_boxinst: extract multi-level features from input images using the BoxInst backbone and neck
compute_loss_boxinst: compute bbox and mask losses for a batch of images and ground truth data samples
predict_masks_boxinst: predict instance segmentation masks, bboxes, labels, and scores on input images
review_boxinst_init: review the BoxInst constructor to understand required backbone, neck, bbox_head, and mask_head parameters
